hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Return Spillover Momentum (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information diffuses slowly along customer-supplier economic networks. Large corporate customers experience demand shocks first, while suppliers' stock prices adjust with a multi-day lag due to investor inattention to cross-firm dependencies. Cumulating customer return signals through a 10-day decay-weighted window captures this gradual price discovery, while subtracting a 3-day price delta counterweight neutralizes short-term price overextension. Because supply chain linkages evolve over months, this signal maintains low turnover (10-15%), boosting BRAIN Fitness.
confounders: Supplier customer contract cancellations not yet reflected in trailing linkage maps
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if customer return signal has zero predictive power for supplier forward excess returns.

hypotheses.title: Put Breakeven Institutional Gamma Cushion (option9)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The 30-day put breakeven price (strike minus option premium) represents the critical threshold where market makers face severe short gamma exposure. When a stock trades comfortably above put breakeven ((close - put_breakeven_30) / close), the equity enjoys strong institutional support and is insulated from forced delta-hedge liquidations. Using a quadratic power transform concentrates weight in equities with the widest safety cushions, paired with 5-day delta reversion to capture optimal entry points.
confounders: Severe broad market liquidity sell-offs that breach all option breakeven strikes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if stocks near put breakeven exhibit higher forward returns than stocks with wide buffers.

hypotheses.title: Intra-Subindustry Low-Beta Defensive Anomaly (model51)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The low-beta anomaly is a well-documented behavioral anomaly driven by leverage-constrained investors bidding up high-beta equities for lottery-like payoffs. By selecting low-beta equities within each subindustry (-beta_last_60_days_spy), we eliminate sector-level macro exposure and capture pure idiosyncratic alpha. With a 60-day rolling baseline, portfolio turnover is naturally suppressed (under 10%), creating high capital efficiency and high Fitness.
confounders: Rapid market regime shifts where high-beta growth stocks experience sustained speculative rallies
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if intra-subindustry low-beta stocks underperform high-beta peers over multi-year cycles.
